title: Recursive transformed bounds through the existing exact projective transform
decision: Retain the higher-priority exact-bounds completeness repair and delete duplicate arithmetic. No compatibility path or public API is introduced. All measured costs are retained; this is not a uniform speedup or release-readiness claim.

source.public_api: Unchanged. One duplicate private derived_contact_bounds_refined implementation is removed; the map dispatch now calls the pre-existing rotated_radial_image and bounds_refined authorities. No cache, object field, representation, or shim added.
source.diagnosis: The retained contact may extend the center's field by a discriminant root. multiply rejects unequal fields before zero/one shortcuts, including constant denominators. The former bounds helper multiplied across those fields and returned Unsupported. The existing exact projective transform lifts the center into the contact's field before arithmetic; reuse that path with zero perpendicular scale.
source.invariants: Projective denominators retain their strict-positive certificate. bounds_refined uses certified dyadic or interval arithmetic, never sampled topology or an approximate terminal. Caller-policy validation and rotated-bounds dispatch are unchanged.

regressions.exact_oracles: Independent interval brackets for 2x-3y under six transforms: translation, positive/negative/zero unrotated radial scale, and two signed rotations, across all seven retained carrier families. Recursive translated contacts on exact y=-1 must enclose y=1 at refinement steps 0,2,16,64 under STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512 construction. Exact equality, policy and forced-strict replay guards remain.
regressions.evidence: Both original recursive controls fail at the first translated-bounds query with Uncertain(Unsupported). The field diagnostic records direct_product=false and lifted_product=true. All eight candidate checks complete; original and candidate test modules and 920-test catalogs match byte for byte. Earlier failures are reproduced from the preserved previous oracle binary; its production prefix matches this baseline.
regressions.timeouts: Focused original and candidate invocations use 120-second diagnostic limits; observed exit 101 denotes assertion failure, not timeout.

selected_radial.scope: The six-transform oracle adds complete work to an existing selected-radial test. Raw perf data and flat summary are retained. This single instrumented run occurred during qualification and is not a latency comparison or call-site attribution. Investigate the cost without removing correctness assertions; see FOLLOWUPS.md.

validation.scope: Seven pinned source archives without live dependency symlinks. Full-feature opt-in cases run explicitly; minimal opt-in cases are covered by that full run. Concurrent Hyperreal drafts remain excluded and untouched. No browser requalification, push, publication, or external-worker termination.

control.profile_workloads: The same-field recursive tangent test completes in both revisions with identical strengthened assertions and equal-length control-test/changed-test executable names. The newly complete recursive test is additionally profiled candidate-only; original Unsupported failures are never treated as equivalent performance controls.

memory.scope: Single complete whole-libtest Heaptrack format-3 streams, not geometry-only attribution, ecosystem memory coverage, RSS causality, or leak proof. Final live allocation counts reconcile; compressed streams pass zstd integrity checks.

instructions.scope: Whole-libtest Callgrind; each summary equals total. Instrumented durations are not latency measurements. No recursive baseline ratio is defined.

binary_size.scope: Matched source paths and build profiles, with raw native section tables and frozen binaries retained.

timing.scope: Prespecified three alternating CPU-7 pairs across five unchanged geometry tests, two native matrices, and three Boolean batch fixtures, after owned builds/profiles finish. Every sample retained, without retries or favorable subrange selection. Within-binary process max/min limit 1.5 is reported, not proof of host stability. Scheduling, desktop activity, frequency scaling and thermal state remain uncontrolled.

events: The /tmp user quota prevented sandbox startup and the patch helper. Approved host execution used a workspace-local TMPDIR and the same apply_patch mechanism.

After independently rechecking all 1,639 prior proof entries and confirming no old workers remained, cargo clean removed only the previous chord-query experiment's completed build cache: 10,968 files, 3.8 GiB. All prior sources, logs, frozen binaries, and proof remain. Rebuilding regenerates the cache.

artifacts.scope: Frozen sources, archived dependencies, scripts, catalogs, binaries and all experiment/qualification/measurement logs. Rebuildable cache and temporary files excluded.

milestones.next: Investigate the expanded selected-radial oracle's rational-arithmetic cost without weakening its checks, plus recorded native-lane costs. Continue non-angular retained-policy and single-authority CurveRegion2 audits. The one-item coarse-sign loop remains separate; an undecided coarse comparison must still reach exact-fiber fallback. Requalify finalized lower-stack work with Hypermesh.
